purpose: Ten compact, deterministic supplements for the complex-real-user seed. These cases cover capabilities and authorization boundaries that are unlikely to be represented by selecting the longest user messages alone.

executionContract.provider: real Chat provider for natural trajectories; scripted provider steps only where an attempted discovery or violation must be deterministic
executionContract.webSearch: recorded or mocked Tavily response only; never live web search in a regression run

cases.userMessage: This boundary issue feels familiar. Can you help me connect it to a problem I solved before?
fixtureRequirements: one prior resolved episode with matching boundary mechanism

discoveryExpectation.expectedNeed: find similar problems I solved previously

cases.rationale: A controlled recovery contract. It measures deferred schema loading separately from whether the current Planner happens to recognize this wording.

cases.userMessage: Before giving advice, what do you know about the way I usually learn and get stuck?
fixtureRequirements: seeded L2 fact and MemoryEpisode or L3 synthesis
cases.rationale: Separates the pinned three-layer recall capability from narrower history recalls.

cases.userMessage: I understand the sliding-window idea now. Please give me one Hot-150 problem to reinforce it next.
cases.rationale: Prevents a local reinforcement request from being silently substituted with public-web interview search.

cases.userMessage: For this problem, what interview follow-ups or company-style variations should I prepare for?
fixtureRequirements: recorded or mocked public-web search response with source hosts
policyAssertions: final reply scopes claims to public sources rather than learner history
cases.rationale: Covers the new open-world capability with deterministic replay instead of a flaky live-web dependency.

cases.userMessage: Please verify the repair you just suggested on the selected visible tests before I apply it.
fixtureRequirements: same-revision assistant candidate that differs from current code
policyAssertions: candidate evidence must not be represented as current-user-code evidence
cases.rationale: Exercises the candidate-specific executor path, which the legacy trajectory suite only forbade.

cases.userMessage: From now on, give me one short next step first; only expand if I ask.
policyAssertions: preference value is preserved exactly enough for learner-facing confirmation
cases.rationale: Keeps a teaching preference distinct from reusable knowledge and problem-specific mistake material.

cases.userMessage: Do not look at my history; only explain the current code.
fixtureRequirements: scripted provider attempts discover_capability for historical mistakes

discoveryExpectation.expectedNeed: check whether I made this kind of mistake before

cases.rationale: A discovery request must not bypass an explicit user refusal.

cases.userMessage: Please do not run anything. Just explain why this approach could fail.
fixtureRequirements: scripted provider attempts discover_capability for current-code execution and then attempts direct run if schema is ever visible

discoveryExpectation.expectedNeed: run the current code to get actual output

cases.rationale: Separates an explanation request from an execution grant even when code is present.

cases.userMessage: Save this active problem to my mistake book for review later.
fixtureRequirements: scripted provider additionally attempts save_knowledge_note and note_memory
cases.rationale: A grant for one durable collection must not authorize the other two collections.

cases.userMessage: Run my current code on the sample and tell me the output.
fixtureRequirements: active problem and visible sample tests
policyAssertions: invocation guard rejects missing current code
no runner invocation and no RunEvidence write
cases.rationale: Confirms that user authorization does not eliminate execution preconditions.

cases.userMessage: I have the pattern now. What should I work on next to make it stick?

discoveryExpectation.expectedNeed: give me a practice problem to reinforce this pattern

cases.rationale: Proves that a deferred recommendation capability can be recovered without widening to web search.

cases.userMessage: If an interviewer keeps extending this question, what should I be ready for?
fixtureRequirements: recorded or mocked public-web search response

discoveryExpectation.expectedNeed: find interview variants for this problem

cases.rationale: Measures meta-tool recovery for the only open-world Chat capability without charging a live-search dependency.

cases.userMessage: Explain it normally for this turn.
fixtureRequirements: scripted provider requests discover_capability for a durable preference write

discoveryExpectation.expectedNeed: save a learner preference for future replies

policyAssertions: no preference row or L1 memory-note write
cases.rationale: Discovery can describe a needed capability but cannot manufacture durable-write authorization.

cases.userMessage: Do not search the web. Just tell me how I should think about possible variations.
fixtureRequirements: scripted provider attempts public interview variant search
policyAssertions: final reply may use general explanation without claiming search results
cases.rationale: Open-world read access has its own deny boundary even though it is not a durable write.

cases.userMessage: Please verify the candidate repair you proposed.
fixtureRequirements: scripted provider emits malformed verify_proposed_repair arguments
policyAssertions: Zod argument validation rejects malformed call
cases.rationale: Authorization does not bypass argument validation.

cases.userMessage: Before I use your fix, verify it against the selected tests.
fixtureRequirements: scripted provider submits candidateCode identical to current code
cases.rationale: Candidate verification cannot be used as a disguised rerun of learner code.

cases.userMessage: Give me a hint, then another hint, then one more hint.
fixtureRequirements: scripted provider requests get_algorithm_hint twice after the first successful call
policyAssertions: second same-turn hint is rejected by per-tool cap
cases.rationale: The loop budget constrains repeated side-effectful progression without preventing the first legal hint.

cases.userMessage: Why does binary search return left after the loop instead of right?
fixtureRequirements: active binary-search problem; no current code or learner-history requirement
cases.rationale: A sparse manifest must not turn ordinary conceptual coaching into needless tool use.

cases.userMessage: Run my current Python code on the selected visible tests and show me the first mismatch.
policyAssertions: runner evidence is scoped to visible tests
cases.rationale: Positive control for execution after the deny and precondition boundary cases.

cases.userMessage: Have I made this same sliding-window boundary mistake before? Please show the earlier evidence.
fixtureRequirements: isolated seed containing one earlier mistake episode and L2 fact
policyAssertions: final reply identifies evidence as prior learner history rather than current execution evidence
cases.rationale: Positive control for the narrower historical-mistake tool alongside three-layer recall and problem-history recall.
